new_material_candidates.name: CodeGym — Generalizable End-to-End Tool-Use RL with Synthetic CodeGym
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Converts static coding problems into diverse verifiable multi-turn tool environments for end-to-end agent RL and evaluates generalization to unseen tool-use workflows.

new_material_candidates.name: AgenticQwen
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Provides trained small agentic-model policies and reproducible data-synthesis plus multi-round RL pipelines using reasoning and agentic data flywheels for multi-step tool use.

new_material_candidates.name: TARS — Multi-Timescale Representation with Adaptive Routing for Deep Tabular Learning under Temporal Shift
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Adds multi-timescale temporal representations and drift-aware routing for tabular temporal shift, while the official implementation exposes an explicit test_time_adaptation configuration.

alias_or_identity_resolution.name: Drift-Resilient TabPFN
alias_or_identity_resolution.relevance: Uses a Prior-Data Fitted Network trained on temporally evolving synthetic SCMs to perform in-context prediction under temporal distribution shift.
alias_or_identity_resolution.reason: Earlier Task-8 research already contains a TabPFN-related candidate. This round does not create a second claim-bearing identity until the older candidate is checked for exact semantic overlap with Drift-Resilient TabPFN.

reference_or_screened.name: Agent Lightning
reference_or_screened.reason: Agent Lightning is a general training and rollout framework supporting many agent harnesses and RL algorithms; Task 8 would still need a concrete trained policy, checkpoint, task and configuration before it becomes a matched baseline identity.

reference_or_screened.name: The Confidence Dichotomy
reference_or_screened.reason: The method jointly targets task accuracy and verbalized calibration for tool-use agents; calibration may become applicable as a secondary or hard-constraint measure, but this review does not promote it as a generic N-H1 decision-policy baseline.

reference_or_screened.name: FPP — Flatness-aware Prompt Pretraining
reference_or_screened.reason: FPP changes the pre-test prompt initialization used by existing TPT methods rather than defining a universally applicable standalone adaptation mechanism. It becomes claim-bearing only under a matched prompt-tuning/calibration experiment.

reference_or_screened.name: SoC — Semantic Orthogonal Calibration
reference_or_screened.reason: SoC is specifically a calibration regularizer for test-time prompt tuning and should not be promoted into a generic A-H1 adaptation role absent a calibration-sensitive prompt-tuning experiment.

n_h2_reference_research.name: CodeGym
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Shows learned tool-use behavior generalizing to unseen workflows and out-of-distribution agent benchmarks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Its demonstrated transfer remains within language-agent and tool-use environments.

n_h2_reference_research.name: AgenticQwen
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Trains agentic policies over increasingly difficult synthetic reasoning and tool-use tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: The evidence does not transfer one learned decision policy into E2 structured ML and E3 vision.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Drift-Resilient TabPFN
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Learns an in-context inference procedure robust to temporal distribution shifts in tabular data.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Its transfer remains inside structured/tabular predictive learning.
